claims.text: When antispasmodics fail: sustained-release enteric-coated peppermint oil 0.2-0.4 mL or 180-360 mg TID.
claims.quote: When antispasmodics fail, peppermint oil, particularly a sustained-release enteric-coated formulation at 0.2 to 0.4 mL or 180 to 360 mg, 3 times daily, demonstrates effective smooth muscle relaxation through calcium channel blockade by L-menthol.
